user.title: Deeper Connect
user.description: Address of your Deeper device (34.34.34.34 in router mode, or its LAN/WAN-side IP).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The saved password no longer works. Enter the current admin password.

init.title: Deeper Connect options
init.description: Turn on only the feature groups you need: each one adds entities and, for some, extra polling. City-level tunnel locations send only the tunnel exit-node IPs to ipinfo.io (fallback: geojs.io); off by default, country is always shown without any lookup.

data.geo_lookup: Look up exit-node city and map position online (needs DPN)

apps.title: App Relocator
apps.description: Each chosen app gets a relocation dropdown. Any app can also be relocated with the deeper_connect.set_app_relocation service.

clients.title: Access Control
clients.description: Each chosen client gets a route-mode sensor and a blackholed problem sensor, so you can alert when a device is cut off. The Blackholed clients count always covers every client. Defaults to the clients pinned in the Deeper app.

set_app_relocation.name: Set app relocation
set_app_relocation.description: Route an app through a tunnel, use direct access, or clear its relocation.

config_entry.name: Device
config_entry.description: Which Deeper device (optional if you only have one).

app.name: App
app.description: App key or name as shown in the Deeper UI, e.g. netflix or Disney Plus.

tunnel.name: Tunnel
tunnel.description: A tunnel code such as US, or 'direct' for direct access, or 'not_set' to clear.

set_routing_mode.name: Set routing mode
set_routing_mode.description: Switch between smart route, full tunnel and disabled. The device does not report its kill-switch state, so this sends kill switch = off.

config_entry.name: Device
config_entry.description: Which Deeper device (optional if you only have one).

tunnel.name: Tunnel
tunnel.description: Tunnel code for full mode (defaults to the remembered full-mode tunnel).

options.dpn: DPN: tunnels (devices, exit nodes, refresh, map), routing mode, node selection
options.app_relocator: App Relocator: relocated-apps sensors, app dropdowns
options.access_control: Access Control: per-client routing, blackhole alerts
options.ads_security: Ads Blocker & Security: YouTube ad blocking, SSL bypass, UDP server
options.system: System: auto-update, scheduled reboot, Reboot button
